# Sport Hagleitner

> > Sport Hagleitner: 4th generation family-owned ski and bike rental shop in Saalbach-Hinterglemm, Austria, offering premium equipment from brands like Atomic, Völkl, GIANT, and Scandinavian sportswear.

Founded over 75 years ago, Sport Hagleitner specializes in ski and bike rentals, professional equipment servicing, guided mountain bike tours, and premium sportswear. Located in the renowned Saalbach-Hinterglemm ski region and near Bikepark Leogang, the family business is run by the Hagleitner family (Marcel, Laura, Maick, and Monika) and serves both winter and summer sports enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Ski rental and ski depot services
- Bike rental (e-bikes and mountain bikes)
- Saalbach-Hinterglemm ski region
- Professional ski service and bootfitting
- Bike guiding and mountain biking
- Equipment brands: Atomic, Völkl, GIANT, POC
- Scandinavian sportswear: Sweet Protection, HESTRA, Amundsen Sports, 8848 Altitude
- Family business (4th generation)
- Ski depot with overnight waxing
- Online rental booking
- Bikepark Leogang and BIG 5 Bike Challenge
- Winter and summer sports equipment
- Skiboot fitting services
- Premium outdoor gear and accessories
